finalAssets.prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Create one high-quality realistic 3D product illustration for a beginner Chinese optical networking HTML lesson. Subject: a generic modular carrier optical transport chassis (OTN/WDM platform), front three-quarter view, with one matching plug-in circuit board extracted and resting beside it. Landscape 3:2 composition, warm off-white seamless studio background, soft daylight shadows, restrained silver metal and dark green circuit board. Chassis occupies left 60%, approximately 19-inch rack width and 8U height, metal mounting ears, a few clearly separated vertical service-board faceplates with optical port receptacles, a lower cooling-fan tray and power compartments. No long cable clutter. One vacant slot visibly corresponds to extracted board. Extracted board on right 35%, with long slim vertical metal front panel oriented to match chassis slots, green PCB extending back horizontally, a few ICs, modest heatsink and rear board connector, four optical interface receptacles in its faceplate. Make the mechanical relationship understandable. Realistic optical transport hardware, not an Ethernet switch with a grid of RJ45 sockets, not a PC GPU. Optical ports are small LC-type receptacles without protruding lasers. No screen, neon, glowing fibers, brand, model numbers, text, labels, arrows, decorative objects or humans. This is a generic educational exterior, not a specific manufacturer product. Leave comfortable space around both items.

finalAssets.initialPrompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Create one clean realistic 3D product illustration containing exactly two optical networking products in two equal side-by-side areas, wide 2:1 composition. Warm off-white seamless studio background and soft shadows. LEFT: standalone passive wavelength multiplexer/demultiplexer, a thin silver 19-inch 1U optical rack unit in front three-quarter view. Its front has eight small blue LC optical receptacles evenly grouped on the left and ONE separate common optical receptacle on the right; no RJ45 ports, no LEDs, no LCD, no power cord, no ventilation fans. RIGHT: standalone powered optical amplifier, compact silver 19-inch 1U rack unit at the same perspective. Front has just two small optical receptacles, a tiny status LED group, realistic ventilation; show some side depth with vents, mechanically plausible metal enclosure. Clean accurate connector appearances, no fiber cables necessary. Strong visual distinction: passive unit many optical ports versus amplifier few optical ports plus powered electronics. Objects at similar scale, ample space between them. No brand, words, lettering, numeric labels, arrows, glowing lines or internal cutaways. This is a generic explanatory model illustration, not an actual equipment photo.
finalAssets.editPrompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit this educational illustration only at the optical connectors. Keep both silver boxes, all dimensions, front panel port counts and exact positions, camera perspective, warm background, light, vents, indicators unchanged. Every blue optical connector on BOTH devices must be a FEMALE panel-mount LC optical ADAPTER / RECEPTACLE, with a recessed dark rectangular socket opening and an internal sleeve deeper INSIDE. Remove ALL exposed white cylindrical ferrules / ceramic pins protruding from the front. Those exposed pins belong to male cable plugs and are wrong for these fixed equipment ports. Recessed empty sockets ready for a patch cable to plug into; no attached plugs, cables, caps, or projections. Left unit has 8 grouped recessed optical receptacles and one separate common receptacle; right unit has 2 recessed optical receptacles. Maintain blue surrounding plastic housings but make front openings flat/recessed. No text, label, logo or other changes.
